assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate
raising clinical suspicion for supraventricular tachycardia
a secondary complaint of palpitations documented under R00.2
a mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) is ordered for continuous rhythm monitoring
This diagnostic procedure requires advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines
the clinical indication directly supports that the monitoring is necessary to detect the symptomatic arrhythmia
